$description: SKYPhoenix semantic tokens — DARK theme. Status: PROPOSED-DERIVED, NOT EXTRACTED. CompanyWebsite has no dark theme (verified 2026-07-18: no prefers-color-scheme rule, no Tailwind darkMode config, no toggle — see source-ledger.md). These values are DERIVED from extracted brand tokens by the documented rules below and REQUIRE BRAND-OWNER APPROVAL before product use. Brand hues are never altered; only surface/text mappings are proposed.
$derivation_rules: Brand hues (primary family, secondary, accent) are reused unchanged from base.json — no invented colors.
Neutral surfaces reuse the site's own extracted dark neutrals where they exist (footer #111827 / #1f2937 family from the extracted text scale, inverted).
Text colors invert the extracted gray scale (text-primary #1f2937 <-> near-white #f9fafb, both values present in the extracted palette).
Semantic alert colors keep extracted text hues, swapping bg/text roles; verify contrast before adoption.
Every pairing must be contrast-checked (WCAG 2.2 AA) at adoption time; this file proposes, it does not certify.

deferred.note: This file is materially incomplete vs tokens/light.json. The following light.json token groups have no dark counterpart yet and are set at adoption, not here:
missing_color_tokens: border-strong (present but unpaired with a light-equivalent rationale)
deferred.missing_component_section: the entire `component` section (button-primary/secondary/outline/danger, status-badges) present in light.json has no dark proposal at all
deferred.carry_over_note: No light.json values are intended to carry over unchanged into dark — every dark-surface pairing requires its own contrast-checked proposal per $derivation_rules; nothing here should be assumed inherited from light.json without an explicit dark entry.
deferred.resolution: brand-owner approval + contrast evidence required before these are added and before this file's $status can move off proposed-derived
